visualCharacteristics.layout: 3 tiles per row from 900px (2 from 600px, 1 below); 16:9 thumbnail with a centred play icon overlay; caption below
visualCharacteristics.colorScheme: white tiles, dark caption, dark translucent play icon
visualCharacteristics.interaction: clicking the thumbnail or caption opens the video in a modal <dialog> with a native <video controls> (autoplay) for .mp4 links; non-mp4 links open in a new tab; Escape / close button / backdrop click closes and pauses, focus returns to the tile

contentPattern.structure: one row per video: [thumbnail picture] | [H3 caption, paragraph containing a link to the MP4 (or video page)]
contentPattern.summary: video tiles: thumbnail, caption, video link
